# s419 — relay-brief.md template states the no-background-shell rule

The built-in `relay-brief.md` template's Rules section tells the orchestrator that it and every role run their shell commands in the foreground and background none, matching relay v10's Waiting rule.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:** the no-`cd` rule (s391 adds it to the contract and, if it wants, to this template), the template's Stop bullet wording (s412 item 1), a project's own override of the template, and any contract text change.

## Why

Found in the s402 review. v10 made "every role runs its own shell commands in the foreground and backgrounds none" part of Every brief and the orchestrator's Waiting rule (`src/slicer/ai.py`). The brief that `slicer ai relay-brief` prints from `src/slicer/templates/relay-brief.md` says to wait for every role and process, but not that no shell command is backgrounded, so an orchestrator started from that brief can miss it until it reads the contract.

- `CHANGELOG.md` under Changed. `docs/` only where it quotes the template.
